description: PM2.5 now in a city: the latest hourly value, its 24-hour, 7-day, 30-day and year-to-date averages with its rank among all measured cities, the US EPA category, how it compares with the WHO guideline, and the "why it ranks here" notes (patterns in its own history and nearby fire, smoke and volcano evidence, named as likely causes, never confirmed), and the local hours its air was usually worst and cleanest over the last 30 days. Each measured city's trust says what stands behind it: checked (reference monitors at 2+ sites), one (a single reference site) or low (3+ low-cost sensors). Cities without a monitor get a model estimate, labelled as one, plus few_sensors when one or two low-cost sensors measure there (not ranked). No forecasts.

city.description: City as its page path ("us/los-angeles"), a SmogRank URL, or a name ("Lahore", "Delhi, India"). find_city lists the paths.

name: city_air
title: Air quality now in a city
